description: Machine-verifiable registry of Charter's implemented assurance claims (enforced by test/gates/claims-backed.sh).

claims.summary: Within one atomic store merge, creating an instance beats terminating it and terminating beats obfuscating (spec 005.3).
Explicitly assigned facts survive rebase and saturation with their value, since-stamp, expiry, and origin intact (spec 004.3).
When saturateStratum converges on a state, an additional derivation pass over the stratum produces no new facts (spec 004.5).
At the state returned by saturateStratum, every consequence derivable from that state by the stratum's rules is already present (spec 004.5).
For any monotone stratum, saturateStratum computes the unique Tarski least pre-fixpoint above the pre-stratum state (spec 004.5).
State.buildIndex 8-bit DomMap radix buckets preserve exact entry order and agree identically with State.lookup even under hash collisions.

Driver-structural soundness: every live runPhrase step matches the DeclPhraseStep driver case-structure (error rollback, stratification guard, clock step, invariant check; paired with evaluator-independent Charter.Core.Meaning, D41, #65).
Driver-structural completeness: every DeclPhraseStep driver derivation is computed identically by runPhrase (paired with evaluator-independent Charter.Core.Meaning, D41, #65).

Evaluator-independent expression completeness: every judgment derivable in the fuel-free relational semantics DeclEval (Charter.Core.Meaning) is computed identically by M.eval once fuel bounds term depth (Law 9, D41, #65).

Evaluator-independent expression soundness: every value returned by M.eval on IsDeclCoreTerm satisfies the fuel-free relational semantics DeclEval without referencing M or DomMap caches (Law 9, D41, #65).
Evaluator-independent compiled phrase correspondence: DeclCPhraseMeaning (which calls no evaluator function) agrees identically with Interp.evalClockStep and Interp.semPhrase (Law 9, D41, #65).
Single-step and multi-step phrase traces over identical initial state and spec produce identical configurations and outputs (G1.4).
State.makeAssignments preserves value, since-stamp, expiry, and origin of unrelated types and untouched unrestricted instances (G1.4).
Half-open [t0, t0 + d) creations hold at t0 + d - 1 and expire at t0 + d and t0 + d + 1 (T25).
No transition (successful or failed) ever moves state.time backwards (009.1, G1.4).
Lawfulness and institutional validity are orthogonal on occurred transitions across all four (lawful, valid) quadrants (Law 2, T01-T03).
An already-converged stratum completes saturateStratum in one non-mutating pass (G1.5).
Monotonic SymbolTable interning resolves every newly or previously interned string back to its exact spelling while preserving prior IDs (G1.5, T42).
Assignment batches writing to disjoint DomId sets commute observationally on State.lookup across all instances (G2.2 partial-order reduction).
Any state predicate holding invariantly along a trace satisfies WeakUntil regardless of termination horizon (G2.3).
Bounded-response satisfaction (EventuallyWithin d1) is monotone under deadline relaxation d1 <= d2 (G2.3).
Boolean equality (==) on Elem and Tagged coincides with propositional equality (=).
Violated(d) query and post-phrase violation reporting agree for holding duty instances (spec 006.2, 006.5).
Per-phrase kernel_rfl checkpoints compose into whole-program and scenario summary decisions with zero axioms (spec 013.4).
Pure-Lean kernel-reducible SHA-256 implementation matches empty, single-block, and multi-block NIST FIPS 180-4 test vectors via rfl (D18).
Every CIR LawVersion epoch emitted by elaboratePhrases satisfies Spec.WellFormed (closed domains, resolved aliases, valid act/duty targets, and stratifiable derivations, D18).
Every institutional Power declaration in a WellFormed CIR Spec carries a non-empty Valid when competence condition (005.10, D21, G3.1).
Pure-Lean RFC 2104 HMAC-SHA256 matches RFC 4231 Test Case 2 via decide +kernel with zero extra axioms (D27, G4.1).
Strong Kleene three-valued guard evaluation (yes, no, undetermined) is a strict conservative extension of classical two-valued Bool with De Morgan duality (D22, G3.2).
A valid institutional Finding resolves prior Conflicted supporting and rebutting evidence to Established (Mission Law 3, D22, T07).
Audience-scoped confidential evidence redaction in ReasonGraph never alters lawful or valid verdicts (D22, T43).
Extralegal advisory Note annotations on trigger phrases never alter post-state Config or emitted transition judgments (D22, T04).
Single-pass topological decision-DAG evaluation agrees identically with the declarative undefeated-rule specification across all outcomes and conflicts (D23, G3.3).
Two unranked active defeasible rules prescribing distinct outcomes return explicit Conflict rather than last-rule-wins (D23, T21).
Multi-level Catala exception-to-exception chains resolve deterministically across base, first-tier exception, and second-tier exception states (D23, T22).
Exact integer minor-unit tiered fee calculation (20 @ 2% + 280 @ 5%) equals 1440 cents ($14.40) and rejects inexact truncation under ExactOrReject (D24, T10).
MulDivRound Floor never exceeds Ceil across all non-zero denominators, with banker's NearestEven midpoint rounding proved (D24, G3.4).

Across any valid CIR Amend trajectory under active reflexive Immunity entrenchment, the entrenchment immunity itself, all Protected rules, and all Entrenched Invariants remain preserved (D11, D25, G3.5, T24).
Serializable reservation locks keep aggregate account reservations bounded by balance (D26, G3.6, T09).
Consolidation subtracting intercompany subsidiary equity counts subsidiary underlying assets once rather than twice (D26, G3.6, T14).
Partial performance preserves non-negative remaining debt and exact total obligation sum (D26, G3.6, T19).
Reservations in ExecutedUnknown (PendingExternalOutcome) are never auto-expired or released by clock progression until explicit reconciliation (D27, G4.3, T35).
Lowered GuardIR state-transition guards accept an event if and only if Charter.Server.evaluateServerEvent returns Allow and transition to the identical CIR configuration (D28, G5.1, T33).

SolidityIR step execution accepts a call if and only if the contract is unpaused, the caller is authorized, the compiled guardExpr evaluates to true, and storage transitions via create-beats-terminate (D42, #66, Law 9).
Scalar expressions lowered to SolidityIR evaluate under execSolExpr to the exact SolVal corresponding to Charter.Core.Meaning.DeclEval (D42, #66, Law 9).

Emitted Solidity (.sol + ABI) and Quint (.qnt) surface texts carry Law-10 checked tags and are validated via 3-way stateful differential traces, counterexample replay, and CI solc/Foundry + quint + z3 execution (D42, #66).
Mandatory authorship reflection ensures no statement signed by author can supply a base/input fact attributed to another actor or tender evidence under another issuer (D43, Law 6, Law 10).

Monotone auditability proved end-to-end over Charter's live evaluator: any bundle judged lawful and valid in network n1 remains identically permitted in every grown network n2 (growing n1 n2) while its basis law remains agreed and its statements remain unrevoked (D43, JustAct Theorem 3.20).
Author-signed statement revocations invalidate targeted bundles (revocation_invalidates_bundle) while preserving all unrelated bundles without freezing global agreements (D43, JustAct §6.3.5).

Unrestricted statements gossip with zero communication-breach overhead (public_gossip_always_lawful), while forwarding restricted statements outside their permitted audience records a CommViolation and bars unauthorized recipients from relying on the leaked statement (D43, JustAct §7.2.3).
Commitment-bound RedactedAttestations yield the exact same closed-bundle verdict on non-confidential actions as raw private statements while exporting zero Confidential facts (D43, JustAct §7.2.4).
Every justification bundle produced by dependency-sliced synthesizeBundle satisfies permittedBundle over Charter's live evaluator (D43, JustAct §7.2.1).

Evaluated directly over Charter's live M.eval, a notice-gated Duty (Due within dur After notice) evaluates to false at every clock instant while notice has not occurred in the agent's view (D43, JustAct §7.2.2).
End-to-end zero-axiom kernel decisions over concrete programs, scenarios, and standard-library module instantiations.
Unified contextual parser and evaluator pass the 196-file upstream eFLINT 4.1.0.1 corpus without --eflint, modulo 39 documented tolerances.
Normative statements in drafted specification chapters 001-015 and 018 are covered by executable conformance fixtures.
Internal VeilSpec transition structure matches Phase-0 Law sigma semantics (retargeting to live Core.Spec + external Veil syntax scheduled for G1/G5).
Internal guard transition function matches Phase-0 Law sigma compliance/validity (retargeting to live Core.Spec + solc/EVM parity scheduled for G1/G5).
Parameterized RatchetSpec preserves entrenched core predicates across valid trajectories on Law sigma (retargeting to live Amend acts scheduled for G3.5).
